model_claim.criterion: Presence of vocab:ruleLength with minCount 1 and nodeKind sh:IRI
model_claim.explanation: The shape declares the property path, a required minimum count and the node kind, satisfying the input readiness checks.

independent_assessment: Correctly describes existing presence/IRI checks, but the criterion is not established as a source obligation by E2; IRI-only is not specified there.

model_claim.criterion: ruleLength value must be a qudt:QuantityValue with decimal numericValue and unit metre
model_claim.explanation: Nested node shape enforces qudt:numericValue of type xsd:decimal and qudt:unit with hasValue unit:M, matching the regulation clause.

independent_assessment: Code ranges implement decimal/unit readiness. Labeling this as implementation of the operative source condition is unsupported. It omits the separately supplied reference relation; there is no explicit sh:class check either. Any ontology-range inference is a different mechanism and is not explained by this coverage account.
